title: 2026 Financial Infrastructure Permission and Operating-Receipt Windows
question: What independently material institutional events fall inside the fixed civil windows April 14–18, May 4–8, May 24–28 and July 3–7, 2026, and do any constitute a verifiable maturation of the January financial-infrastructure baseline?
bluf: The four fixed windows do not show one January object maturing neatly at every later date. They show a narrower institutional sequence: the April window opens permissions, the early-May window discloses operating boundaries and a completed pilot, the late-May window formalizes proposals and legal containers, and the July window carries a conditional charter plus a bounded DTC production non-receipt. The repeated factual problem is who may enter, clear, custody, settle, reverse or receive credit; same actor and same domain do not establish same object or causation.
entities: Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City
